title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
summary: Microsoft Teams will add pinch-to-zoom on shared screens for easier viewing of details, rolling out worldwide from mid-November to late December 2026. This feature is enabled by default in all meetings, with no compliance issues identified. Organizations should update sharing policies and inform users.
body:
Updated November 24, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and Why:]

Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on late November 2026 and expect to complete by late December 2026 (previously late November).

Targeted Release (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by mid-November 2026.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

This capability will be enabled for all meetings by default, as an improvement to additional zooming controls.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

Review your organization’s sharing policies and inform users and support teams about the addition to existing sharing experience.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
